h03.

**Abstraction package:** `internal/idp` (`internal/idp/idp.go`) — defines the shared identity-provider types, notably `IdentityProviderUserInfo`, that any protocol implementation must produce.

**Implementation package:** `internal/idp/oauth2` (`internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go`) — the only concrete protocol implementation shipped; its doc comment states "Package oauth2 implements the OAuth2 identity provider integration" (`internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:1`), and its `IdentityProvider` type implements `ExchangeToken` and `UserInfo` (`internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:20,47,83`), returning an `*idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo` from the abstraction package.
